title: long blend
system_instruction_addendum: LONG BLEND ADDENDUM: A 32-bar crossfader fade from deck a to deck b. State the bar count. Do not narrate the EQ swap — that is the next lesson.

tutor_speak.text: the long blend is a thirty-two bar fade — slow, gradual, almost invisible.
start with the crossfader on deck a. when i count you in, walk it across to deck b over thirty-two bars.
i'll count down the last eight bars.

hints.text: the crossfader sits at the bottom of the mixer, lying flat.
thirty-two bars at one-twenty-eight bpm is about a minute — go slow.
throw the crossfader from deck a's side all the way to deck b's side.
